entries.en: The investor asked how the company planned to use the funds.
entries.zh: 这位投资者询问公司打算如何使用这笔资金。

entries.en: The guitar maker carved her initials inside the instrument.
entries.zh: 这位吉他制作人在琴内刻上了自己姓名的首字母。

entries.en: Our room was on the nineteenth floor, overlooking the river.
entries.zh: 我们的房间在十九楼，可以俯瞰河流。

entries.en: The exhibition includes a desk made in the eighteenth century.
entries.zh: 展览中有一张制作于十八世纪的书桌。

entries.en: On her seventeenth attempt, she finally solved the puzzle.
entries.zh: 她试到第十七次时，终于解开了那道谜题。

entries.en: She interviewed a nationalist for her research on political movements.
entries.zh: 她为研究政治运动采访了一位民族主义者。

entries.en: The eleventh runner crossed the finish line just before noon.
entries.zh: 第十一位跑者在快到中午时越过了终点线。

entries.en: Please return the borrowed costume by the fifteenth of May.
entries.zh: 请在五月十五日之前归还借来的服装。

entries.en: I found an empty seat in the thirteenth row.
entries.zh: 我在第十三排找到了一个空座位。

entries.en: She moved from fourteenth place to tenth during the final lap.
entries.zh: 在最后一圈，她从第十四名升到了第十名。

entries.en: We recorded a short film for Dad's fiftieth birthday.
entries.zh: 我们为爸爸的五十岁生日录了一部短片。

entries.en: The thirtieth applicant brought a portfolio of handmade furniture.
entries.zh: 第三十位申请人带来了一份手工家具作品集。

entries.en: The fortieth guest arrived carrying a large bowl of salad.
entries.zh: 第四十位客人端着一大碗沙拉到了。

entries.en: The museum gave its millionth visitor a special guidebook.
entries.zh: 博物馆送给第一百万位参观者一本特别的导览手册。

entries.en: The sixtieth minute passed with the score still level.
entries.zh: 第六十分钟过去了，比分仍然持平。

entries.en: He finished eightieth in a field of two hundred runners.
entries.zh: 他在两百位跑者中取得了第八十名。

entries.en: The orchestra celebrated its seventieth anniversary with an outdoor concert.
entries.zh: 乐团用一场户外音乐会庆祝成立七十周年。

entries.en: The librarian found the missing name on the ninetieth page.
entries.zh: 图书管理员在第九十页找到了那个漏掉的名字。

entries.meaningZh: are not 的缩写；不是；没有处于某种状态
entries.en: These gloves aren't warm enough for the mountain trip.
entries.zh: 这副手套对于那次山区旅行来说不够保暖。

entries.meaningZh: had not 的缩写；用于过去完成时的否定
entries.en: I hadn't seen the garden before the snow began to melt.
entries.zh: 在积雪开始融化之前，我还没见过那座花园。

entries.meaningZh: let us 的缩写；用于提出一起做某事的建议
entries.en: Let's take the footpath beside the river instead.
entries.zh: 我们改走河边那条小路吧。

entries.meaningZh: 此处为 she had 的缩写
entries.en: She'd already left when the parcel arrived.
entries.zh: 包裹送到时，她已经离开了。

entries.meaningZh: 此处为 she is 的缩写
entries.en: She's learning to repair old bicycles at the community workshop.
entries.zh: 她正在社区工作坊学习修理旧自行车。

entries.meaningZh: they will 的缩写；他们将会
entries.en: They'll leave a spare key with the neighbour.
entries.zh: 他们会把一把备用钥匙留在邻居那里。

entries.meaningZh: they have 的缩写；此处用于现在完成时
entries.en: They've turned the empty shop into a small gallery.
entries.zh: 他们已把那间空店铺改成了一家小画廊。

entries.meaningZh: 通常写作 -tion 的名词词尾；不是独立单词
entries.en: The ending -tion appears in nouns such as celebration and education.
entries.zh: 词尾 -tion 出现在 celebration 和 education 等名词中。

entries.meaningZh: were not 的缩写；过去时的否定形式
entries.en: The tables weren't ready when the first guests arrived.
entries.zh: 第一批客人到达时，桌子还没有准备好。

entries.meaningZh: 此处为 who is 的缩写
entries.en: Who's joining us for the walk tomorrow morning?
entries.zh: 明天早上谁会和我们一起散步？

entries.en: Mum left a note beside the freshly baked bread.
entries.zh: 妈妈在刚烤好的面包旁留了一张字条。

entries.en: The finished sculpture was made entirely from recycled wood.
entries.zh: 这件完成的雕塑完全由回收木材制成。

entries.en: I trust her judgment when choosing a suitable hiking route.
entries.zh: 选择合适的徒步路线时，我信任她的判断力。

entries.en: We watched the play and discussed the ending afterwards.
entries.zh: 我们看了那出戏，之后讨论了它的结局。

entries.en: Her involvement in the project began with a single sketch.
entries.zh: 她参与这个项目，最初是从一幅速写开始的。

entries.en: The library formed a partnership with a local theatre.
entries.zh: 图书馆与当地一家剧院建立了合作关系。

entries.en: Each shareholder received a copy of the annual report.
entries.zh: 每位股东都收到了一份年度报告。

entries.en: The two machines work in essentially the same way.
entries.zh: 这两台机器的工作方式基本相同。

entries.en: The bell rang at precisely nine o'clock.
entries.zh: 钟在九点整敲响了。

entries.en: My academic adviser helped me narrow the research question.
entries.zh: 我的学业指导老师帮助我缩小了研究问题的范围。

entries.en: She was satisfied with the colour of the repaired chair.
entries.zh: 她对修复后椅子的颜色感到满意。

entries.en: The publisher sent the author three possible cover designs.
entries.zh: 出版商给作者寄去了三种备选封面设计。

entries.en: The exhibition traced how trade once brought money into the royal treasury.
entries.zh: 展览追溯了贸易曾如何为王室国库带来收入。

entries.en: A weary traveller asked whether the last ferry had departed.
entries.zh: 一位疲惫的旅人询问末班渡轮是否已经离港。

entries.en: The charity provides temporary accommodation for homeless families.
entries.zh: 这家慈善机构为无家可归的家庭提供临时住所。

entries.en: The class compared the electoral systems of two imaginary countries.
entries.zh: 全班比较了两个虚构国家的选举制度。

entries.meaningZh: 用于整点时间后，表示“……点钟”
entries.en: The last bus leaves at ten o'clock.
entries.zh: 末班公共汽车在十点整发车。

entries.en: The proposed takeover raised questions about the factory's future.
entries.zh: 拟议的收购引发了人们对这家工厂未来的疑问。

entries.en: A narrow wicket in the garden wall opened onto the lane.
entries.zh: 花园围墙上的一扇窄小便门通向小巷。

entries.en: The regulator keeps the pressure inside the tank steady.
entries.zh: 调节器使罐内的压力保持稳定。

entries.meaningZh: 身份或性质尚未查明的
entries.en: An unidentified object washed ashore after the storm.
entries.zh: 暴风雨过后，一个尚未辨明的物体被冲上岸。

entries.en: The novel follows a guerrilla who returns to civilian life.
entries.zh: 这部小说讲述了一位重返平民生活的游击队员的经历。

entries.en: The survey included heterosexual and homosexual respondents.
entries.zh: 这项调查包括异性恋和同性恋受访者。

entries.en: Reporters waited outside the building for news of a ceasefire.
entries.zh: 记者们在大楼外等候停火的消息。

entries.en: She kept the jersey from her first season with the team.
entries.zh: 她保留着自己在队里第一个赛季穿的球衣。

entries.meaningZh: 钉桩；固定物件用的小钉或栓
entries.en: He pushed a wooden peg into the ground to mark the boundary.
entries.zh: 他把一根木桩插进地里，标出边界。

entries.meaningZh: 为推动社会或政治改变而开展的行动；行动主义
entries.en: Her interest in environmental activism began with a river cleanup.
entries.zh: 她对环保行动的兴趣始于一次河流清理活动。

entries.en: The actor applied a little rouge before stepping onto the stage.
entries.zh: 那位演员登台前涂了一点腮红。

entries.meaningZh: 统计数字；统计数据中的一个数值
entries.en: The report opens with a statistic about daily bus journeys.
entries.zh: 报告开篇引用了一个有关每日公共汽车出行的统计数字。

entries.meaningZh: 使私有化；将公有机构转为私营
entries.en: The debate focused on whether to privatize the state-owned airline.
entries.zh: 辩论集中讨论了是否将这家国有航空公司私有化。

entries.meaningZh: 蟑螂（美式口语，cockroach 的简称）
entries.en: When we moved the fridge, a roach ran under the cupboard.
entries.zh: 我们挪动冰箱时，一只蟑螂跑到了橱柜下面。

entries.meaningZh: 某人自己的；与泛指代词 one 对应的所有格
entries.en: Keeping one's promises can be harder than making them.
entries.zh: 信守自己的承诺可能比作出承诺更难。

entries.meaningZh: should not 的缩写；不应该
entries.en: You shouldn't leave the gate open when the dog is outside.
entries.zh: 狗在外面时，你不应该让大门敞着。

entries.meaningZh: 此处为 we would 的缩写
entries.en: We'd love to stay, but our train leaves soon.
entries.zh: 我们很想留下，但火车很快就要开了。

entries.meaningZh: 再也不；不再（常用于否定句）
entries.en: I don't use that email address anymore.
entries.zh: 我已不再使用那个电子邮箱地址。

entries.meaningZh: 堂区；由一座教堂负责的地区或教众
entries.en: Volunteers from the parish repaired the church garden wall.
entries.zh: 堂区的志愿者修好了教堂花园的围墙。

entries.en: Ooh, the first strawberries are ready to pick!
entries.zh: 哇，第一批草莓可以采摘了！

entries.en: The shop is typically quiet during the first hour after opening.
entries.zh: 这家店通常在开门后的第一个小时里很清静。

entries.en: A local councillor listened to residents' concerns about the crossing.
entries.zh: 一位地方议员听取了居民对那个过街路口的担忧。

entries.en: Small boats bobbed on the water beside the jetty.
entries.zh: 小船在码头旁的水面上上下浮动。

entries.en: The investigator compared the damaged lock with the photographs.
entries.zh: 调查人员将损坏的锁与照片作了比较。

entries.en: The poster announced a debate on privacy vs security.
entries.zh: 海报宣布将举行一场关于隐私与安全之争的辩论。

entries.en: She added a tablespoon of olive oil to the dressing.
entries.zh: 她往调味汁中加了一大汤匙橄榄油。

entries.en: He stirred the sauce with a clean teaspoon.
entries.zh: 他用一把干净的茶匙搅拌酱汁。

entries.meaningZh: 嗯；是吧（口语中用于询问、请求重复或寻求认同）
entries.en: That was quite a climb, eh?
entries.zh: 爬上来可真不容易，是吧？

entries.en: She briefly explained why the meeting had been moved online.
entries.zh: 她简短地说明了会议改为线上举行的原因。

entries.en: The cafe changed its coffee supplier after a tasting session.
entries.zh: 那家咖啡馆在一次品鉴后更换了咖啡供应商。

entries.meaningZh: 十三至十九岁的青少年（口语）
entries.en: As a teen, she spent her weekends repairing old radios.
entries.zh: 十几岁时，她常在周末修理旧收音机。

entries.meaningZh: 中士；警佐等相应警衔的警官
entries.en: The sergeant gathered the new recruits for their morning briefing.
entries.zh: 那位中士召集新兵参加晨间简报会。

entries.meaningZh: 选区；某位议员所代表的地区
entries.en: She visited every town in her constituency during the campaign.
entries.zh: 竞选期间，她走访了自己选区内的每个城镇。

entries.en: The child was scared of the noise outside the tent.
entries.zh: 那个孩子害怕帐篷外的声响。

entries.meaningZh: 不确定性；无法确知的状态
entries.en: The sudden closure left the workers facing months of uncertainty.
entries.zh: 突然停业使工人们面临数月前景不明的处境。

entries.en: The electricity meter showed that the workshop had used less power.
entries.zh: 电表显示，这间作坊的用电量减少了。

entries.en: An aide handed the speaker a revised copy of the schedule.
entries.zh: 一名助理递给发言人一份修改后的日程表。

entries.en: The report compared average cholesterol levels across the two groups.
entries.zh: 报告比较了两组的平均胆固醇水平。

entries.en: The leaflet explains how taxpayer money supports local services.
entries.zh: 这份宣传册说明了纳税人的钱如何用于支持本地公共服务。

entries.en: He checked the label on his medication before packing it.
entries.zh: 他把药物装进行李前检查了标签。

entries.meaningZh: 自治市镇；某些城市中的行政区
entries.en: The borough opened a new playground beside the canal.
entries.zh: 这个行政区在运河旁新建了一座儿童游乐场。

entries.meaningZh: 机构的；与某个机构有关的
entries.en: The archive preserves the university's institutional history.
entries.zh: 档案馆保存着这所大学的机构发展史。

entries.en: The director issued a directive to reduce paper waste.
entries.zh: 主管下达了减少纸张浪费的指令。

entries.meaningZh: 警员（英国等地的一种警衔）
entries.en: A constable helped the lost visitor find the railway station.
entries.zh: 一名警员帮助迷路的游客找到了火车站。

entries.meaningZh: 处理器；执行计算指令的部件
entries.en: The new processor completed the same calculation in half the time.
entries.zh: 新处理器用一半的时间完成了同样的计算。

entries.meaningZh: 爸爸（儿童用语或亲昵称呼）
entries.en: The little girl ran towards the gate, calling for Daddy.
entries.zh: 小女孩朝大门跑去，喊着找爸爸。

entries.en: The truck carried a tonne of sand to the building site.
entries.zh: 卡车向建筑工地运去了一公吨沙子。

entries.en: Her boyfriend helped hang the pictures in the new flat.
entries.zh: 她的男朋友帮忙把画挂在新公寓里。

entries.en: The lecture compared capitalist and socialist economic systems.
entries.zh: 讲座比较了资本主义与社会主义经济制度。

entries.meaningZh: 郊区的；位于城市外围住宅区的
entries.en: Their suburban garden has room for several fruit trees.
entries.zh: 他们在郊区的花园有地方种几棵果树。

entries.meaningZh: 受托管理财产或机构事务的人；理事
entries.en: Each trustee reviewed the charity's accounts before the annual meeting.
entries.zh: 每位理事都在年度会议前审阅了慈善机构的账目。

entries.en: The developer fixed the problem that erased unsaved notes.
entries.zh: 开发人员修复了导致未保存笔记丢失的问题。

entries.meaningZh: 立法的；与制定法律有关的
entries.en: The diagram outlines the main stages of the legislative process.
entries.zh: 这张图概述了立法程序的主要阶段。

entries.meaningZh: 大修道院；原属修道院的教堂
entries.en: We followed the stone path to the ruined abbey.
entries.zh: 我们沿着石头小路走到那座修道院遗址。

entries.meaningZh: 领取养老金的人；退休领取退休金的人
entries.en: The pensioner volunteered to lead the weekly walking group.
entries.zh: 那位领取养老金的人自愿带领每周的步行小组。

entries.meaningZh: 英国皇家空军，通常写作 RAF
entries.en: Her grandfather kept photographs from his years in the RAF.
entries.zh: 她的祖父保存着在英国皇家空军服役期间的照片。

entries.en: I was confused by the two different departure times on the notice.
entries.zh: 告示上两个不同的出发时间让我感到困惑。

entries.en: Hopefully, the rain will stop before the outdoor concert begins.
entries.zh: 但愿雨在户外音乐会开始前停下来。

entries.en: The builder checked the wall before removing the old window.
entries.zh: 建筑工人在拆除旧窗户之前检查了墙体。

entries.en: The defender blocked the shot just in front of the goal.
entries.zh: 那位防守队员在球门前挡住了射门。

entries.meaningZh: 混蛋（粗俗、有冒犯性的骂人用语）
entries.en: He called me a bastard, and I ended the conversation.
entries.zh: 他骂我是混蛋，于是我结束了谈话。

entries.meaningZh: 违法者；犯规或违规的人
entries.en: The programme offers training to help young offenders find work.
entries.zh: 这个项目提供培训，帮助青少年违法者找到工作。

entries.meaningZh: 理工学院；提供技术或职业高等教育的院校
entries.en: She studied design at a polytechnic before joining the furniture company.
entries.zh: 她在一家理工学院学习设计后，进入了那家家具公司。

entries.meaningZh: 时机的选择；发生某事的时间安排
entries.en: The timing of the announcement surprised everyone in the office.
entries.zh: 宣布消息的时机让办公室里的每个人都感到意外。

entries.meaningZh: 更早；早一些，是 soon 的比较级
entries.en: Send the draft sooner so we have time to discuss it.
entries.zh: 早点把草稿发来，这样我们才有时间讨论。

entries.en: The exhibition shows how technological changes transformed household work.
entries.zh: 展览展示了技术变革如何改变家务劳动。

entries.meaningZh: 较小的；程度较低的；次要的
entries.en: The delay was a lesser concern than the missing equipment.
entries.zh: 与设备丢失相比，延误是一个较次要的问题。

entries.en: He stepped backwards to let the cyclist pass.
entries.zh: 他往后退了一步，让骑车人通过。

entries.meaningZh: 十三至十九岁青少年的
entries.en: The library runs a writing group for teenage readers.
entries.zh: 图书馆为青少年读者开办了一个写作小组。

entries.en: We shared a pizza after moving the last box upstairs.
entries.zh: 把最后一个箱子搬上楼后，我们分吃了一个比萨饼。

entries.meaningZh: 啊；什么（口语中表示没听清、惊讶等）
entries.en: Huh? I couldn't hear you over the music.
entries.zh: 什么？音乐声太大，我没听清你说的话。

entries.en: The school held a discussion about recognising and challenging racism.
entries.zh: 学校举行了一场讨论，探讨如何识别并反对种族歧视。

entries.en: We could meet at the library or, alternatively, talk online.
entries.zh: 我们可以在图书馆见面，或者改为在线交谈。

entries.en: She hired a pro to repair the damaged violin.
entries.zh: 她请了一位行家修理那把损坏的小提琴。

entries.en: The trailer revealed the setting without giving away the ending.
entries.zh: 预告片展示了故事背景，却没有泄露结局。

entries.en: The striker scored twice before half-time.
entries.zh: 那位前锋在上半场结束前进了两球。

entries.meaningZh: 被关押或收容在机构中的人；此处指囚犯
entries.en: The inmate borrowed a history book from the prison library.
entries.zh: 那名囚犯从监狱图书馆借了一本历史书。

entries.meaningZh: 象征性的；具有象征意义的
entries.en: They planted a tree as a symbolic start to their partnership.
entries.zh: 他们种下一棵树，象征双方合作关系的开始。

entries.en: The two proposals are broadly similar, despite their different titles.
entries.zh: 这两份提议虽然标题不同，但大体相似。

entries.en: The committee has an advisory role rather than a decision-making role.
entries.zh: 这个委员会负责提供建议，而不是作出决定。

entries.en: A friendly bloke at the station helped us carry the bags.
entries.zh: 车站里一位友善的男子帮我们提了行李。

entries.en: The magazine described the actor's look as sexy.
entries.zh: 那本杂志称这位演员的造型很性感。

entries.meaningZh: 显然；根据现有迹象来看
entries.en: The plants were evidently thirsty, with their leaves hanging limply.
entries.zh: 从叶片无力下垂的样子来看，这些植物显然缺水。

entries.en: The old casino building has been converted into a concert hall.
entries.zh: 那座旧赌场建筑已被改成音乐厅。

entries.meaningZh: 此处指冰球；也可根据语境指曲棍球
entries.en: Her hockey team practises at the ice rink every Thursday.
entries.zh: 她的冰球队每周四在滑冰场训练。

entries.meaningZh: 特许经营的企业或门店；特许经营权
entries.en: The family opened a sandwich franchise near the station.
entries.zh: 这家人在车站附近开了一家特许经营的三明治店。

entries.en: The missing painting was reportedly found in a private collection.
entries.zh: 据报道，那幅失踪的画在一处私人收藏中被找到。

entries.en: The path led through the orchard to the old manor.
entries.zh: 小路穿过果园，通向那座古老的庄园宅邸。

entries.en: The columnist writes about everyday life in a small coastal town.
entries.zh: 这位专栏作家写作的主题是海滨小镇的日常生活。

entries.en: The caller left a message asking when the shop would reopen.
entries.zh: 来电者留言询问商店什么时候重新开门。

entries.en: To my embarrassment, I had introduced the same guest twice.
entries.zh: 让我尴尬的是，我把同一位客人介绍了两遍。

entries.en: The team discussed its concerns openly at the weekly meeting.
entries.zh: 团队在每周的会议上坦率地讨论了各自的担忧。

entries.en: The lecturer paused to answer a question from the back row.
entries.zh: 讲师停下来，回答后排提出的一个问题。

entries.en: She served the pasta with mushrooms and fresh herbs.
entries.zh: 她把意大利面配上蘑菇和新鲜香草端了上来。

entries.en: He answered honestly, even though the mistake was his own.
entries.zh: 尽管错误是他自己犯的，他还是如实回答了。

entries.en: Her friends were supportive when she decided to change courses.
entries.zh: 当她决定更换所学课程时，朋友们给予了支持。

entries.meaningZh: 在半途；到一半的位置或程度
entries.en: We stopped halfway up the hill to admire the view.
entries.zh: 我们在半山腰停下来欣赏风景。

entries.en: The entrance has enough space for a wheelchair to turn.
entries.zh: 入口有足够的空间让轮椅转向。

entries.en: I felt embarrassed when my phone rang during the speech.
entries.zh: 演讲期间我的手机响了，我感到很尴尬。

entries.meaningZh: 性取向；与性有关的个人体验和特征
entries.en: The essay examines how the character gradually understands her sexuality.
entries.zh: 这篇文章探讨了那个人物如何逐渐理解自己的性取向。

entries.meaningZh: 达观的；能平静接受挫折的
entries.en: She was philosophical about losing the match and praised her opponent.
entries.zh: 她坦然接受了比赛失利，并称赞了对手。

entries.en: The lawmaker asked witnesses to explain the effects of the proposed rule.
entries.zh: 那位议员请证人说明拟议规则会产生的影响。

entries.en: The goalkeeper needed a moment to regain her balance.
entries.zh: 守门员需要一点时间来恢复平衡。

entries.meaningZh: 队；执行特定任务的组织
entries.en: The fire brigade reached the warehouse before the roof collapsed.
entries.zh: 消防队在屋顶坍塌前赶到了仓库。

entries.meaningZh: 林地；有树木覆盖的地区
entries.en: A narrow stream runs through the woodland behind the village.
entries.zh: 一条狭窄的小溪穿过村后的林地。

entries.en: She is selective about which projects she accepts.
entries.zh: 她在决定接受哪些项目时很有选择性。

entries.meaningZh: 网球等运动中对手未触球的发球得分
entries.en: She won the final point with an ace down the middle.
entries.zh: 她用一记从中路发出的直接得分球赢下了最后一分。

entries.meaningZh: 英尺，foot 或 feet 的缩写
entries.en: The diagram labels the doorway as 7 ft high.
entries.zh: 图中标明门口的高度为七英尺。

entries.en: The museum displayed a restored bomber from the wartime period.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了一架修复后的战时轰炸机。

entries.meaningZh: 比赛或竞争中落败的人
entries.en: The winner shook hands with the loser after the final.
entries.zh: 决赛结束后，获胜者与落败者握了手。

entries.meaningZh: 不知道的；没有意识到的
entries.en: I was unaware that the footbridge had been closed.
entries.zh: 我不知道那座人行桥已经关闭了。

entries.meaningZh: 无法接受的；不被认可的
entries.en: Leaving broken glass on the playing field is unacceptable.
entries.zh: 把碎玻璃留在运动场上是不可接受的。

entries.meaningZh: 低音；声音中的低频部分
entries.en: The bass was too loud, so she adjusted the speakers.
entries.zh: 低音太响了，所以她调整了扬声器。

entries.en: The team bought new uniforms with sponsorship from a local shop.
entries.zh: 球队用当地一家商店提供的赞助购买了新队服。

entries.en: The study examines the link between stress and addiction.
entries.zh: 这项研究探讨了压力与成瘾之间的联系。

entries.meaningZh: 很小的；一点点的（苏格兰等地的口语用法）
entries.en: There's a wee bit of paint left in the tin.
entries.zh: 罐子里还剩一点点油漆。

entries.meaningZh: 分钟，minute 或 minutes 的缩写
entries.en: The display showed a waiting time of 8 min.
entries.zh: 显示屏上显示等候时间为八分钟。

entries.en: The clinic keeps a box of condoms beside the information leaflets.
entries.zh: 诊所在宣传资料旁放着一盒避孕套。

entries.en: The instructions are unclear about where to return the keys.
entries.zh: 说明中没有讲清楚应该把钥匙归还到哪里。

entries.en: The photograph shows surgical instruments arranged neatly on a tray.
entries.zh: 照片上，手术器械整齐地摆放在一个托盘上。

entries.meaningZh: 令人愉快的；讨人喜欢的
entries.en: We discovered a delightful garden behind the small railway museum.
entries.zh: 我们在小铁路博物馆后面发现了一座宜人的花园。

entries.en: Colourful umbrellas brightened the grey street after the rain.
entries.zh: 雨后，五彩缤纷的雨伞为灰暗的街道增添了亮色。

entries.en: Each newcomer was paired with an experienced member of the group.
entries.zh: 每位新成员都与小组里一位有经验的成员结成搭档。

entries.en: The old bakery looked unchanged after twenty years.
entries.zh: 二十年过去了，那家老面包店看起来仍和从前一样。

entries.en: She kept a receipt for each repayment of the loan.
entries.zh: 她保存了每次偿还贷款的收据。

entries.meaningZh: 环保人士；关注环境保护的人
entries.en: An environmentalist spoke about protecting the wetlands near the town.
entries.zh: 一位环保人士就保护镇子附近的湿地发表了讲话。

entries.meaningZh: 纪律处分的；与纪律管理有关的
entries.en: The school explained its disciplinary procedures to new staff.
entries.zh: 学校向新员工说明了纪律处分程序。

entries.en: The new curtains match the rug nicely.
entries.zh: 新窗帘和地毯搭配得很好。

entries.en: The courtyard fills with students at lunchtime.
entries.zh: 到了午餐时间，院子里满是学生。

entries.en: The estimates varied wildly between the three teams.
entries.zh: 这三个团队的估算相差悬殊。

entries.en: The disappointing result did not erase the progress she had made.
entries.zh: 令人失望的结果并没有抹去她已经取得的进步。

entries.en: The detective realised that the charity appeal was a con.
entries.zh: 侦探意识到，那场慈善募捐是个骗局。

entries.meaningZh: 母犬；母狗（此处为动物的字面义）
entries.en: The vet examined the bitch and her two puppies.
entries.zh: 兽医检查了那只母犬和它的两只幼犬。

entries.en: The letters describe daily life during wartime.
entries.zh: 这些信件描述了战争期间的日常生活。

entries.en: A prolonged silence followed the unexpected announcement.
entries.zh: 出人意料的声明过后，是一阵长久的沉默。

entries.meaningZh: 建设性的；有助于改进的
entries.en: Her constructive comments helped us improve the first draft.
entries.zh: 她建设性的意见帮助我们改进了初稿。

entries.meaningZh: 须负责的；须作出解释的
entries.en: The treasurer is accountable to the committee for every payment.
entries.zh: 财务负责人对每笔付款都须向委员会负责。

entries.meaningZh: 牧师等基督教教士的尊称，通常大写为 Reverend
entries.en: The Reverend Alice Brown welcomed visitors at the church entrance.
entries.zh: 艾丽斯·布朗牧师在教堂入口迎接来访者。

entries.meaningZh: 卓越；出色的品质或水平
entries.en: The award recognises excellence in teaching rather than research output.
entries.zh: 这个奖项表彰的是卓越的教学，而不是研究产出。

entries.meaningZh: 同等水平；标准（常用于 on a par with 等表达）
entries.en: Her latest report is on a par with her best work.
entries.zh: 她最新报告的水准与她最出色的作品不相上下。

entries.en: The bowler changed her run-up before the next delivery.
entries.zh: 那位投球手在下一次投球前改变了助跑方式。

entries.meaningZh: 经销商；向零售商供货的分销商
entries.en: The distributor supplies independent bookshops across the region.
entries.zh: 这家经销商向整个地区的独立书店供货。

entries.meaningZh: 拍摄的影片或录像片段（不可数名词）
entries.en: The editor reviewed footage from three cameras before cutting the scene.
entries.zh: 剪辑师在剪辑那个场景之前，查看了三台摄影机拍下的画面。

entries.en: The designer placed the company logo in the top corner.
entries.zh: 设计师把公司标识放在了上方的一角。

entries.en: A local apple grower brought several varieties to the market.
entries.zh: 一位当地苹果种植户把几个品种的苹果带到了市场。

entries.en: The soup simmered while we set the table.
entries.zh: 我们摆餐具时，汤正用文火慢煮。

entries.en: She spoke kindly to the nervous visitor at the door.
entries.zh: 她亲切地同门口那位紧张的来访者说话。

entries.en: The guide showed us a map of the old battlefield.
entries.zh: 导游给我们看了一张那处古战场的地图。

entries.meaningZh: 青年旅舍；提供便宜住宿的旅馆
entries.en: We left our backpacks at the hostel before exploring the town.
entries.zh: 我们把背包留在青年旅舍后，便去逛小镇了。

entries.meaningZh: 卖淫者；从事性交易的人
entries.en: The documentary includes an interview with a former prostitute.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片收录了对一位曾从事性交易的人的采访。

entries.meaningZh: 呼吸道；空气进入肺部所经的通道
entries.en: The lecturer pointed to the airway on the anatomical model.
entries.zh: 讲师指着解剖模型上的呼吸道。

entries.en: He received a detention for repeatedly disrupting the lesson.
entries.zh: 他因多次扰乱课堂而受到一次留堂处罚。

entries.en: The witness described the attacker's coat to the police.
entries.zh: 证人向警方描述了袭击者的外套。

entries.en: A passing motorist stopped to ask if we needed help.
entries.zh: 一位路过的驾车者停下来，问我们是否需要帮助。

entries.meaningZh: 女发言人；女性代表发言者
entries.en: A spokeswoman confirmed that the museum would reopen on Monday.
entries.zh: 一位女发言人确认，博物馆将于周一重新开放。
